messages:
sylvia: FYI AcmeHW raised a reconciliation issue: their Azure marketplace usage shows active entitlement but zero billed tokens for some on-prem appliances. can we triage?
omar: which field is mismatching on our side vs partner payloads?
paul: partner says subscription_id matches, but our recon is not finding any meter_dimension for those rows. their exporter sometimes emits meter_dimension: \"\" for offline devices.
jake: that will break the join. our current recon join uses (subscription_id, meter_dimension, window_start). if meter_dimension empty, it drops.
sylvia: partner attached a redacted payload. pasting below: 
```json
{
  "partner": "acmehw",
  "offer": "acme-edge-1",
  "subscription_id": "sub_A1B2C3",
  "usage": [{ "timestamp": "2026-03-18T23:00:00Z", "units": 0 }],
  "entitlement": { "plan_code": "edge-pro", "state": "active" },
  "meter_dimension": ""
}
```
leah: zero units + empty meter_dimension = classic gap. we previously saw a midnight aggregation rule that filters out sub-hour events with <1 unit then emits a zero-row; aggregator left meter_dimension empty in that path.
omar: finance noted credit adjustments for some of these subs. i'm worried downstream invoices already marked them as free, causing mismatch.
jake: short-term fix: add tolerant join fallback in recon: if meter_dimension is null/empty, match on offer+subscription_id and map to default meter_dimension = \"edge.sessions\" when entitlement.plan_code == \"edge-pro\". i'll gate behind a feature flag.
leah: add ETL pre-flight that normalizes missing meter_dimension to \"unknown\" and emits a metric (meter_dimension_missing). we can alert when rate > threshold.
paul: partner success will request full raw payload backfill for the affected window. they agreed to provide 72 hours of raw exports.
sylvia: action items + owners?
jake: (1) implement tolerant join fallback + feature flag — owner: jake — ETA: EOD tomorrow.
leah: (2) add normalization metric + dashboard tile + alert on >50 missing/hour — owner: leah — ETA: today.
omar: (3) prepare invoice rerun/backfill script for affected subscription_ids — owner: omar/finance — ETA: after partner backfill (target next day).
paul: (4) send partner comms and confirmation of exporter upgrade — owner: paul — ETA: in 2 hours.
sylvia: also consider adding webhook-side validation returning 4xx/422 when required fields missing so partner gets immediate feedback instead of silent drops.
jake: i can prototype a 422 schema error response: ```json { "error": "missing_meter_dimension", "detail": "meter_dimension required for meterized offers; send \"unknown\" if not applicable." } ``` will include helpful docs link.
billing-bot: alert: azure-webhook 422 errors increased for acmehw 2026-03-18T22:50Z..2026-03-18T23:10Z (count=47)
leah: i'll wire the metric to a dashboard tile and set alert threshold to 50/hr.
omar: once partner backfills raw payloads, please drop the subscription_id list here and i'll run the invoice attribution rerun for last 7 days.
paul: posting update to the partner ticket now and asking for payloads.
sylvia: summary: partner to backfill; jake tolerant join + 422 prototype; leah metrics + dashboard + alert; omar invoicing rerun after list; paul partner comms. target resolution date: 2026-03-20.
paul: ack'd, will update thread when partner uploads payloads. :thumbsup:
sylvia: thanks team. if anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
